name: Haoxiangni Health Food Co.,Ltd.
summary: Haoxiangni Health Food Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, procurement, production, and sale of healthy foods in China. It offers jujube and health-preserving freshness products. red dates, roasted nuts and seeds, candied fruits and dried fruits, dried meat and seafood. Haoxiangni Health Food Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Haoxiangni Jujube Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Haoxiangni Health Food Co.,Ltd. in September 2017. Haoxiangni Health Food Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Xinzheng, China.
